title: Data Not Noise
style: 92 BPM clean indie pop, warm male lead with NZ AU lean, fingerstyle electric guitar, soft kick and shaker percussion, vinyl crackle texture, analog synth pad bed, layered background harmonies on chorus, contemplative verses, anthemic chorus, doctrine track, grounded and clear, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — clean guitar, soft kick, vinyl crackle]
Data — not noise
Data — not noise
Every signal counts, every signal… data, not noise

[Verse 1]
Thousand voices in the feed tonight
Most of 'em flicker, none of 'em fight
But buried in the static, there's a steady tone
A real one ringing, a real one's home

Don't chase the loudest, don't chase the trend
Follow the line that won't bend or end
The quiet ones telling you what's true
That's the signal coming through

[Pre-Chorus]
Filter the static, listen for the bell
The answer's in the pattern, the pattern can tell
Not every input deserves a reply
But every real one — you can't pass by

[Chorus]
Data — not noise
Data — not noise
Keep the signal, drop the toys
Data — not noise
Real voices, real choice
Data — not noise

[Verse 2]
336 Hz humming low
Eight sites breathing, that's the flow
48 nodes, all in tune
Reading the room, reading the moon

ZynAsk before you assume
Move don't delete, give the truth room
Bots are witnesses, not executors
Keep the keel — we're the operators

[Pre-Chorus]
Filter the static, listen for the bell
The answer's in the pattern, the pattern can tell
Not every input deserves a reply
But every real one — you can't pass by

[Chorus]
Data — not noise
Data — not noise
Keep the signal, drop the toys
Data — not noise
Real voices, real choice
Data — not noise

[Bridge — stripped, spoken-sung]
Noise is loud.
Signal is steady.
Noise is hungry.
Signal is ready.
Data — not noise.

[Final Chorus]
Data — not noise
Data — not noise
Keep the signal, drop the toys
Data — not noise
Real voices, real choice
Data — not noise

[Outro]
Data… not noise…
Data… not noise…
336 — still ringing
Data — not noise
